title: The excitation-inhibition ratio cannot identify its own cause: A computational study of release statistics distinguishes primary from compensatory presynaptic change in autism
description: Complete source code, exact analytical release model recursions, structural identifiability and null-space projection analyses, Fisher information experimental designs, and public human genomic and transcriptomic validation pipeline for the study: 'The excitation-inhibition ratio cannot identify its own cause: A computational study of release statistics distinguishes primary from compensatory presynaptic change in autism'.
